name: appearance-settings
title: Appearance settings
description: Choose how the interface looks: three theme preview cards, a density choice with a live sample list, and an optional font choice, all applied at once.
docs: Controlled: keep value in state, update it in onChange and apply theme, density and font yourself. The theme previews paint their own palette, so each one is true on any page theme. Leave systemTheme out and System reads the browser; pass fonts={[]} to hide the font choice.
